title: The visual director's answer for the animations pass (S9a): one scene per script beat with its components, placed on spoken words; the code resolves the times, the branding and the ids

beat.description: the script beat id (b1, b2, ...), one scene per beat in order

set_piece.description: a set piece scene (1 or 2 per reel; the hook's is the one landing in the breath)

honesty.description: what the scene's data is: sourced (real screenshot or verified number), mock (illustrative UI), none

at.description: when it starts: scene (the beat's first word), breath (the hook breath, set pieces only), word:<spoken word of this beat>, ms:<offset from the scene start>

word_props.description: timing props that land on a spoken word of this beat, for example {"strike_at": "flagged", "ticks_at": "plans"}

props.description: the component's declared variables (catalog.md): positions, texts, images as research/<file> or brand/<path>, @brand-slot for the brand slot

emphasis.description: optional: the words that get a hit; the script's emphasis words by default

lines.description: hook 2's display line split in 1 to 3 headline lines, the serif phrase between asterisks

wishlist.description: a component you wanted and the library lacks (the reel still uses library components; the builder flags it for the user)
